jobs.title: Content Marketer
jobs.description: Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States In the early 1900s, advertising pioneer Helen Lansdowne Resor helped popularize a new idea: people are more likely to pay attention to something that genuinely interests them than something that simply asks for their attention. Decades later, the channels may have changed, but the principle hasn’t, and we’re looking for someone who wants to apply that principle creatively. Mercury’s Stories team is hiring a Content Marketer to help create, distribute, and amplify exceptional content for founders and entrepreneurs — people building companies, navigating uncertainty, and trying to make better
jobs.why: Mercury wants compelling, attention-grabbing content that resonates with founders, making this an excellent fit for Anas's direct-response copywriting skills.
jobs.proposal_opener: Helen Lansdowne Resor had it right: genuine interest beats intrusive ads every time. I craft startup content that earns attention and drives action.
jobs.flags: Competitive fintech role - attach your strongest content and email samples
jobs.summary: This role focuses on writing engaging, narrative-driven content for startup founders and business owners on Mercury's platform. It spans brand messaging, long-form content, and multi-channel audience building.

jobs.proposal_opener: Great ad performance isn't just budget optimization—it takes sharp hook-reveal copy and creative angles that drive real CVR uplift.
jobs.flags: Paid media emphasis - focus heavily on creative strategy and ad copy side
jobs.summary: This position handles the operational setup, optimization, and management of paid media campaigns across EU markets. It focuses on growth experiments and cross-channel paid performance.

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Manager:in
jobs.description: Jobbeschreibung Hey! Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein! Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly
jobs.why: It centers on German B2B/retail trade marketing, though Anas can pitch consumer offer positioning and persuasive copy principles.
jobs.proposal_opener: Plant-based products need sharp offer positioning that highlights taste and benefits fast—I write copy that turns health benefits into high sales.
jobs.flags: Requires German language & local retail experience
jobs.summary: This role leads trade marketing initiatives and retail channel growth for vly's plant-based milk alternatives in Germany. It includes point-of-sale campaigns, B2B retail partnerships, and promotional strategies.
